dedupe_keys.name: indicateur prospectif de gaz renouvelable dynamique engagee a la maille nationale

description: Indicateur Prospectif de Gaz Renouvelable - Dynamique engagée à la maille nationale is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données restitue la dynamique de production de biométhane engagée par un territoire par rapport à sa consommation de gaz. Le calcul de ce ration s'appuie sur: la production annuelle de biométhane (en cours et à venir) enregistrée dans le registre de capacité dont NaTran est le gestionnaire. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Production. Its keywords are IGR, Prospective, EnR. The portal shows 2021-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
